Interface ChaosDiagnosticsMXBean

@Internal public interface ChaosDiagnosticsMXBean
MXBean interface for the chaos agent diagnostics, registered with the platform MBean server under the object name com.macstab.chaos.jvm:type=ChaosDiagnostics.

This interface follows the JMX MXBean convention (javax.management.MXBean) and exposes operations that operators can invoke from any JMX client (JConsole, JMC, the jmxterm CLI, or management tooling) to inspect the agent without attaching a debugger and, when enabled, to activate and stop plans.

The MBean is registered automatically during agent startup (premain defers it until the application has initialised java.util.logging). If registration fails (e.g., because another MBean with the same name already exists), the failure is logged to System.err and the agent continues without JMX support.

Available operations:

JMX operations exposed by this MXBean
OperationReturn typeDescription
debugDump()String Returns a multi-line human-readable snapshot of the runtime details, all registered chaos scenarios with their state and counts, and the recent activation failures.
listScenarios()String[] One line per registered scenario.
isControlEnabled() (attribute ControlEnabled) booleanWhether the control operations below are allowed.
activatePlan(String)String Activates a plan given as JSON; control operation.
stopScenario(String)boolean Stops a plan activated through activatePlan; control operation.
stopAll()int Stops every plan activated through activatePlan; control operation.

  • Method Details

    • debugDump

      String debugDump()
      Returns a multi-line human-readable diagnostics dump of the current chaos runtime state.

      The dump includes the runtime details; for each registered scenario its ID, scope, current ChaosDiagnostics.ScenarioState, matched and applied counts and reason; and the recent activation failures. Scenarios of a plan with jmxEnabled=false are left out. The exact format is not stable across agent versions and is intended for human consumption only.

      Returns:
      a non-null, non-empty diagnostics string; formatting may include newlines

    • listScenarios

      String[] listScenarios()
      Lists every registered scenario as <id> state=<state> matched=<n> applied=<n>.
      Returns:
      one line per scenario

    • isControlEnabled

      boolean isControlEnabled()
      Whether the control operations (activatePlan(String), stopScenario(String), stopAll()) are enabled: agent argument jmxControl=true, system property macstab.chaos.jmx.control=true or environment variable MACSTAB_CHAOS_JMX_CONTROL=true. Off by default — anyone who can reach the MBean server could otherwise inject faults into the JVM.
      Returns:
      true when control operations are allowed

    • activatePlan

      String activatePlan(String planJson)
      Activates a plan given as JSON (the startup-config format).
      Parameters:
      planJson - the plan
      Returns:
      the ids of the scenarios activated, comma-separated
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if control operations are disabled
      IllegalArgumentException - if the plan is invalid

    • stopScenario

      boolean stopScenario(String scenarioId)
      Stops a scenario that was activated through activatePlan(String), together with the rest of its plan: a plan is activated and stopped as a unit.
      Parameters:
      scenarioId - the scenario id
      Returns:
      true if a plan holding that scenario was stopped
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if control operations are disabled
